intro: Technology leads the sectors tracked in ZCyberNews's ai-security coverage, which spans 75 articles published between 12 April and 29 September 2026. Government, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, and healthcare also feature among affected sectors, with incidents reported globally and across the United States, China, Australia, and North America. Claude Mythos, Midnight Blizzard, and OpenClaw appear among the most covered threat actors. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-5760 at CVSS 9.8, CVE-2026-5752 at CVSS 9.3, CVE-2026-44339 at CVSS 8.6, and CVE-2026-44567 and CVE-2026-45303, both at CVSS 7.7. The severity mix comprises 34 high, 9 critical, 14 informational, and 6 medium items.
